The music maintains a constant 128 BPM tempo with high spectral brightness. (3) A series of metallic 'snap' or camera shutter SFX are introduced in rapid succession, tightly synchronized with the visual appearance of photo cards. The narration shifts from storytelling to an enthusiastic introduction of collaborators. (4) The music swells slightly in volume as the narrator delivers a final promotional pitch. The track concludes with a brief melodic synthesizer flourish and a clean fade, leaving only the primary musical theme audible for the final second.
